description: Short three-cell probe of where the legacy GaWF wrap acts: A = legacy core with the in-loop wrap as the recurrent state (gawf_legacy), B = RNN-aligned core with the wrap on the readout only (gawf_rnncore), D = no wrap at all (gawf_nowrap); two seeds per cell, 24 epochs, run on sjc-remote to compare validation-loss trajectories at equal budget.
source_commit: 8a4dc5c plus the current working-tree utils/ tree (new GaWF placement model types, registration, dispatch map, analysis-side stem mapping); the legacy no-wrap cell is provably identical to the aligned no-wrap cell (experiments/tests/test_clutter_nonlinearity_variants.py::test_rnn_aligned_gawf_equals_legacy_gawf_once_the_wrap_is_disabled), which is why the design has three cells rather than four.

dependency_strategy.throttle: 1 run per GPU (each run holds ~31 GB of the 48 GB A6000)

notes: Cells: A (gawf_legacy, seeds 1-2), B (gawf_rnncore, seeds 1-2), D (gawf_nowrap, seeds 1-2); every cell trains at the identical budget (40h-uint8, seq 32, 24 epochs, patience 0, h256/lr0.005/wd0.001, 5-epoch checkpoints).

Interpretation is pre-registered: A vs B isolates where the wrap sits (both have it), B vs D isolates whether the wrap exists at all (both keep the raw state). A much flatter validation loss than D with the wrap present in B would support the placement hypothesis; B tracking D would support the presence hypothesis.

A 4-seed x 150-epoch pilot (leaf clutter_ablate_rnncore_sjc_v1) and an aborted 40-epoch attempt (clutter_ablate_gawf_cells_short40ep_sjc_v1) were cancelled by explicit user instruction to keep the probe short; their partial outputs are left untouched and are not analysis inputs.

Only validation-loss trajectories are comparable at this budget; test-accuracy-based conclusions require the full 150-epoch runs (gawf_rnncore seeds 1-10 are queued on Amarel as part of 61754570_[20-29]).
